blocks.unit: the five times I check your setup and first block
blocks.context: I start with your intake, history, goals, and available training data. Your first month shows me how that plan fits your real life and legs.

blocks.title: What I Check
blocks.description: Each check catches a different kind of problem.

steps.detail: Confirm TrainingPeaks, communication, calendar constraints, your kickoff call, and the purpose of the first week.
Check device sync, uploaded files, zones, availability, and whether you can find and understand the plan.
Compare the plan with your files, readiness, comments, fuel, and unanswered questions.
Use two weeks of files and comments to adjust zones, dose, schedule, equipment assumptions, and recovery.
Summarize what changed, what still needs watching, and what the next block needs to accomplish.

blocks.question: What is the main purpose of the first 30 days?

options.text: Prove how much training you can survive
Show how the first plan fits your schedule, recovery, and response to training
Set permanent zones after one workout

blocks.explanation: Your first month shows me how the plan fits your schedule, recovery, equipment, and response to training.

blocks.content: I will use the current TrainingPeaks calendar, report changes early, leave useful workout comments, and ask before moving missed work.
You are done here. Open TrainingPeaks, look over the first week, and ask about anything that is unclear.
